#DISTRESS SIGNAL RULES
These rules apply to the Distress Signal gamemode.
Distress Signal does not always operate on a first-contact basis. The round may give you a hint as to what you can expect to find in the AO. You can find this information in the character menu.
- The signal may describe a threat that is unknown, biological, fungal or something else.
- Survivors know the threat exists and may have a general idea of what it is and does.
- Third-party forces do not know what is going on in the AO before they arrive. - The only thing they may know is what the distress signal describes, and that may still be an active threat in the AO.
